questions.question: What is cloud computing according to the AWS whitepaper?
questions.reference_answer: Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of compute power, database, storage, applications, and other IT resources through a cloud services platform via the internet with pay-as-you-go pricing. It provides rapid access to flexible and low-cost IT resources without large upfront hardware investments.
